Date: Mon, 03 Dec 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Authentication anomaly observed — request for IRP and logs

Hi Aditya,

We observed a short window of elevated failed authentications against service tokens for our integration with Redwood between 2028-12-03T04:22Z and 2028-12-03T04:37Z. No data exfiltration appears evident from our initial checks, but this impacted a handful of service calls and triggered our internal alerting.

Can you confirm Redwood has an incident response plan for this type of event and provide the following items so we can complete our SIG/SOC2 evidence packet?

- Initial incident notice and timeline (who saw what and when)
- Redacted auth telemetry (S3/CloudTrail extracts or equivalent)
- Any mitigation actions taken and the final remediation status
- Contact for escalation and expected artefacts delivery time

We treat this as a moderate impact; our compliance team needs the artifacts for a scheduled SOC 2 review. Please advise whether Redwood will provide a packaged evidence bundle and a short postmortem.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Head of Platform Security
Finrise

> We observed a short window of elevated failed authentications ...

Ellen — thanks for the heads up. Quick status from our side:
- Containment: The affected API keys were rotated and the stale tokens disabled at 2028-12-03T04:40Z UTC. No further failed auths observed after rotation.
- Evidence: I pulled an S3 auth log excerpt and an auth-service trace bundle for the 15-minute window. Files: s3_auth_log_excerpt_20281203.ndjson (redacted), auth_service_trace_20281203.json (redacted).
- Initial notice attached (redwood_irp_v1.2.pdf) and an evidence bundle (ir_evidence_bundle_finrise_v1.zip) that includes redacted telemetry, ACL snapshots, and a short containment timeline.

What we're providing in the bundle:

- s3_auth_log_excerpt_20281203.ndjson: redacted keys and IPs (hashed)
- acl_snapshot_dec03.txt: access control snapshot at time of event
- containment_actions.txt: steps and timestamps for rotations and mitigations
- README.txt: explanation of redactions and contact points

Deliverables plan:
- Initial package delivered now (see attached)
- Full postmortem with RCA and long-term mitigations by 2028-12-05 EOD

If you need a SOC2-formatted appendix, we can produce a short crosswalk to the SOC2 control IDs — please confirm which control IDs your auditor will request and we'll include the mapping.

Regards,

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 05 Dec 2028 16:43:00 -08:00
Subject: Final postmortem: Redacted RCA and next steps (Finrise auth anomaly)

Ellen / Tom — attaching the final postmortem for the authentication anomaly you reported. Short summary below and the full PDF is attached.

Executive summary:
- Incident window: 2028-12-03T04:22Z — 2028-12-03T04:40Z (containment 04:40Z)
- Root cause: a transient credential caching bug in our auth proxy caused a small set of stale tokens to be accepted by a legacy verification path during a brief deployment window.
- Impact: ~24 failed auth events and 6 successful calls using stale tokens; all successful calls were limited to a single service principal and involved non-sensitive telemetry only. No customer data was exported.
- Remediation: hotfix deployed 2028-12-03T05:05Z; tokens rotated and additional deploy-time verification added.
- Long-term actions: audit to remove legacy verification path, expand deployment gating, and a quarterly validation test for token revocation flows.

What we included in the attached bundle:
- postmortem_finrise_auth_anomaly_20281205.pdf (RCA and mitigations)
- s3_auth_log_excerpt_20281203.ndjson (redacted — IP and keys hashed)
- redwood_irp_v1.2.pdf (our IRP section relevant to customer-facing incidents)
- Timeline.csv and README.txt

Compliance note: we can produce a SOC2 appendix mapping the artifacts to control IDs and a SIG questionnaire excerpt if your auditor requests it. Let us know the control list; otherwise we'll include the standard SOC2 crosswalk.

We're available for a short walkthrough next week. Proposed times: Thu 2028-12-07 10:00-11:00 PST or Fri 2028-12-08 14:00-15:00 PST. Tell me what works and I will book.

Apologies for the disruption and thank you for your patience.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: postmortem_finrise_auth_anomaly_20281205.pdf (application/pdf)
